name: Mistmeadow
description: A kithkin doun endangered by the approach of Rosheen Meanderer.

description_citations.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A wurm tears up the Wilt-Leaf, turns Mistmeadow into a mudhole and makes the river jump its banks.
timeline.quote: Last time, it tore up the Wilt-Leaf, turned Mistmeadow into a mudhole, and made the river jump its banks.

citation.text: Duskdale Wurm (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At Mistmeadow Gryffid sees fae carry Rhys away at Maralen's orders; Eidren sacrifices his life, and Gryffid brings his remains to Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: When Eidren sacrificed his life to protect Mistmeadow

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mistmeadow Jack, helped by Maralen, reroutes Rosheen away from Mistmeadow in exchange for her scroll.
timeline.quote: Rosheen's path was rerouted by Mistmeadow Jack

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "Awakened". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen's offer of protection to Mistmeadow is repelled by Donal Alloway of Kinscaer.
timeline.quote: Maralen offers Mistmeadow a protection, but is repelled by Donal Alloway

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Ode to Mistmeadow Jack, by Scott McGough and Cory J. Herndon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jack Chierdagh is sent to retrieve an item of Rosheen's to drive her away from Mistmeadow.
timeline.quote: Jack Chierdagh is sent to retrieve an item of Rosheen to drive her away

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Ode to Mistmeadow Jack, by Scott McGough and Cory J. Herndon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The faeries help Jack win the day by stealing Rosheen's scroll, driving her away.
timeline.quote: The faeries help Jack win the day, and drive Rosheen away by stealing a scroll of hers

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Ode to Mistmeadow Jack, by Scott McGough and Cory J. Herndon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jack returns and becomes the Hero of Mistmeadow.
timeline.quote: He returns to Mistmeadow and assume the position of the Hero of Mistmeadow

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Ode to Mistmeadow Jack, by Scott McGough and Cory J. Herndon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
